                                   Resolution 2023-06
                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
                                          For
               RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT FOR THE PURCHASE OF
                               FIRE TURNOUTS

WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue Inc (GFR) applied for a federal grant in 2022 for replacement of 19 set
of expired turnouts and was not awarded the grant; and Resolution 2022-15 approved the replacement of 9 of
the 19 sets of turnouts; and

WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue Inc (GFR) still needs to replace 10 sets of fire turnouts that are past
their 10-year lifespan; and

WHEREAS, the GFR Board of Directors approved this purchase on December 6, 2023; and

THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors supports the purchase of 10 sets of turnouts at a cost not to
exceed $30,000 (THIRTY THOUSAND DOLLARS) from the GFR 406 Capital Account.


PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 to 0 this 20th day of March 2023.





Guy Wade
GBOS Fire Dept Chair                               Attest
